description: English Grammar App is a comprehensive educational platform designed to help learners worldwide master English grammar through interactive, practical exercises. The platform focuses on a hands-on approach, allowing users to practice essential topics such as tenses, conditionals, and modal verbs. By providing a structured environment for repetition and learning, it helps students build confidence in their language skills. Interactive Learning Features The application offers multiple practice mode
